verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Increase lets API callers initiate ACH, wire, RTP and check transfers, optionally held for team-member approval. It does not show any of the story's defining elements: scoped or restricted API credentials, per-key amount caps, counterparty allowlists, or a vendor-documented AI-agent use case. An optional human approval hold and machine-readable docs or a CLI are not a policy-bounded agent-access model, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
